title: Table grain and key audit
task: Profile row counts, distinct keys and duplicate keys across all three fact tables.

title: Orphan anti-join
task: Find medication orders whose encounter key is absent.
hint: Use LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL or NOT EXISTS.

title: Safe fact aggregation
task: Produce department encounter and order metrics without fan-out.
hint: Aggregate encounter and order facts independently before joining.

title: Window ranking
task: Rank departments by encounter volume and explain ties.

title: First encounter cohort
task: Select first encounter per patient and calculate supplied flag proportion.

title: Monthly utilisation
task: Produce monthly orders, encounters with orders and quantity totals.
hint: Use month grain and COUNT(DISTINCT encounter_id).

title: Latest clinical observation
task: Find latest SBP per encounter and summarise it.
hint: Use ROW_NUMBER() by encounter ordered by date and stable ID.

title: Data-quality audit
task: Count non-positive quantity, missing cost and missing class.
hint: Use CASE expressions and explicit null handling.

title: Index and query plan
task: Inspect lookup plan before/after composite index.
hint: Use EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN; describe observed plan, not assumed speed.

title: Cross-domain cohort
task: Count encounters with both SBP observation and medication order.
hint: Use distinct encounter key sets to avoid multiplication.

title: Pre-aggregated join
task: Join encounter-level mean SBP and order count safely.
hint: Aggregate each source to encounter grain before joining.

title: Metric contract
task: Write numerator, denominator, grain, exclusions and caveats for a readmission-like metric.
hint: Treat supplied flag as unvalidated synthetic field; do not claim validated readmission.
